decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 7th June 2005 the extension to the existing single storey detached garage to increase the width of the garage to 5.8m with a 3m high flat roof was lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:
The development falls within the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1, Class E of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 because It would not exceed 3m in height, be more than 5m away from the existing addition to the rear of the house, would not adjoin a public highway, and not result in the coverage of more than 50 percent of the total area of the curtilage of the site (excluding the ground area of the original house).

Condition : 2 - Informatives:
Please note that the dimension of the width of the site shown to be 5.9m, on the submitted drawing, is not accurate as the width is 5.2m - 5.4m.
.

Condition : 3 - The extension to the existing detached garage hereby found to be lawful shall only be used for a purpose incidental to the enjoyment of the single-family dwellinghouse as a domestic garage and for no other purpose (i.e. it shall not be used as a bedroom, living room, office or other business use or as a separate dwelling and should not include toilet, bathroom or kitchen facilities).
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the erection of an extension to existing detached single storey domestic garage to rear of house.
